name: lifeplanner
description: 라이프플래너 Android shell (Capacitor). The web app itself stays the static files at the repo root.

scripts.sync:android: npm run copy:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.test: node scripts/verify-native-shell.mjs && node scripts/verify-copy.mjs && node scripts/verify-tts-split.mjs && node scripts/verify-bible-search.mjs && node scripts/verify-page.mjs
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
